name: Scalar value specification
description: Represents scalar physical quantities by combining a numerical value and a unit. A scalar value specification carries has specified numeric value plus a measurement unit label, and is attached to a specifically dependent continuant through specified by value. Units are drawn from UO or QUDT.
competency_questions: What is the numeric value of this quantity and in which unit is it expressed? Which quality or property does a given scalar value specification specify?
